PILOT AGREEMENT

This Pilot Agreement is between Lumen Analytics, Inc. ("Vendor") and Harcastle Foods Co. ("Customer").

1. Evaluation License. Vendor grants Customer a limited license to use the software service for internal evaluation for 60 days.

2. Fees. There are no fees during the pilot.

3. Feedback. Customer grants Vendor a license to use feedback.

4. Disclaimer. The service is provided as is, without warranty.
